# awscc_mediatailor_prefetch_schedule (Resource)

Definition of AWS::MediaTailor::PrefetchSchedule Resource Type



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name to assign to the prefetch schedule.
- `playback_configuration_name` (String) The name of the playback configuration.

### Optional

- `consumption` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumption))
- `recurring_prefetch_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration))
- `retrieval` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retrieval))
- `schedule_type` (String) The frequency that MediaTailor creates prefetch schedules.
- `stream_id` (String) An optional stream identifier that MediaTailor uses to prefetch ads for multiple streams that use the same playback configuration.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags assigned to the prefetch schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the prefetch schedule.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--consumption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consumption`

Optional:

- `avail_matching_criteria` (Attributes List) If you only want MediaTailor to insert prefetched ads into avails that match specific dynamic variables, set the avail matching criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumption--avail_matching_criteria))
- `end_time` (String) The time when MediaTailor no longer considers the prefetched ads for use in an ad break, as an ISO 8601 date-time.
- `start_time` (String) The time when prefetched ads are considered for use in an ad break, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

<a id="nestedatt--consumption--avail_matching_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consumption.avail_matching_criteria`

Optional:

- `dynamic_variable` (String) The dynamic variable(s) that MediaTailor should use as avail matching criteria.
- `operator` (String) For the DynamicVariable specified in AvailMatchingCriteria, the Operator that is used for the comparison.



<a id="nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_prefetch_configuration`

Optional:

- `end_time` (String) The end time for the window that MediaTailor prefetches and inserts ads in a live event, as an ISO 8601 date-time.
- `recurring_consumption` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_consumption))
- `recurring_retrieval` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_retrieval))
- `start_time` (String) The start time for the window that MediaTailor prefetches and inserts ads in a live event, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

<a id="nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_consumption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_prefetch_configuration.recurring_consumption`

Optional:

- `avail_matching_criteria` (Attributes List) The configuration for the dynamic variables that determine which ad breaks that MediaTailor inserts prefetched ads in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_consumption--avail_matching_criteria))
- `retrieved_ad_expiration_seconds` (Number) The number of seconds that an ad is available for insertion after it was prefetched.

<a id="nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_consumption--avail_matching_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_prefetch_configuration.recurring_consumption.avail_matching_criteria`

Optional:

- `dynamic_variable` (String) The dynamic variable(s) that MediaTailor should use as avail matching criteria.
- `operator` (String) For the DynamicVariable specified in AvailMatchingCriteria, the Operator that is used for the comparison.



<a id="nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_retrieval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_prefetch_configuration.recurring_retrieval`

Optional:

- `delay_after_avail_end_seconds` (Number) The number of seconds that MediaTailor waits after an ad avail before prefetching ads for the next avail.
- `dynamic_variables` (Map of String) The dynamic variables to use for substitution during prefetch requests to the ADS.
- `traffic_shaping_retrieval_window` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_retrieval--traffic_shaping_retrieval_window))
- `traffic_shaping_tps_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_retrieval--traffic_shaping_tps_configuration))
- `traffic_shaping_type` (String) Indicates the type of traffic shaping used to limit the number of requests to the ADS at one time.

<a id="nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_retrieval--traffic_shaping_retrieval_window"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_prefetch_configuration.recurring_retrieval.traffic_shaping_retrieval_window`

Optional:

- `retrieval_window_duration_seconds` (Number) The amount of time, in seconds, that MediaTailor spreads prefetch requests to the ADS.


<a id="nestedatt--recurring_prefetch_configuration--recurring_retrieval--traffic_shaping_tps_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_prefetch_configuration.recurring_retrieval.traffic_shaping_tps_configuration`

Optional:

- `peak_concurrent_users` (Number) The expected peak number of concurrent viewers for your content.
- `peak_tps` (Number) The maximum number of transactions per second (TPS) that your ad decision server (ADS) can handle.




<a id="nestedatt--retrieval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retrieval`

Optional:

- `dynamic_variables` (Map of String) The dynamic variables to use for substitution during prefetch requests to the ad decision server (ADS).
- `end_time` (String) The time when prefetch retrieval ends for the ad break, as an ISO 8601 date-time.
- `start_time` (String) The time when prefetch retrievals can start for this break, as an ISO 8601 date-time.
- `traffic_shaping_retrieval_window` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retrieval--traffic_shaping_retrieval_window))
- `traffic_shaping_tps_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retrieval--traffic_shaping_tps_configuration))
- `traffic_shaping_type` (String) Indicates the type of traffic shaping used to limit the number of requests to the ADS at one time.

### Nested Schema for `retrieval.traffic_shaping_retrieval_window`

Optional:

- `retrieval_window_duration_seconds` (Number) The amount of time, in seconds, that MediaTailor spreads prefetch requests to the ADS.


<a id="nestedatt--retrieval--traffic_shaping_tps_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retrieval.traffic_shaping_tps_configuration`

Optional:

- `peak_concurrent_users` (Number) The expected peak number of concurrent viewers for your content.
- `peak_tps` (Number) The maximum number of transactions per second (TPS) that your ad decision server (ADS) can handle.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediatailor_prefetch_schedule.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the prefetch schedule

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediatailor_prefetch_schedule.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_mediatailor_prefetch_schedule.example "arn"
```
